template.name: Boards of Canada
template.about: Detuned, wobbling tape synths, dusty breaks, VHS haze, slow tempos.

project.name: Boards of Canada
project.notes:
BOARDS OF CANADA  (Music Has the Right to Children, Geogaddi; 1998-2002)

TECHNIQUE (sourced)
- As children they bounced parts between two cassette decks "until the tapes started getting
  so distorted that you couldn't do it any longer"; "not big fans of laptop music" (Pitchfork,
  2005, via bocpages.org).
- Tape-machine and SH-101 specifics: unconfirmed.

THIS TEMPLATE
Detuned OB-Xf pad through CHOWTapeModel "Slightly Wobbly", Surge XT "VHS Soundtrack" lead
through CHOWTapeModel "Woozy Chorus", a drum rack swung at 54% for your breaks (The drum rack plays one-shots synthesized for these templates (CC0, no recordings), in the voice of the machine each channel is named for, with a starter beat in the pattern; replace them with your own samples for the real machine.), bass,
a voice-fragment Sampler.

MIX NOTES
- Everything a little out of tune: wobble on pads and lead, never on the bass.
- Drum Bus: a hard built-in compressor, kHs Bitcrush 22 kHz / 12 bits at 60%.
- Master: CHOWTapeModel "Warm Tape", Lemon Limiter; -14 to -11 LUFS.
- Loudness: streaming plays back near -14 LUFS integrated (Spotify), so a louder master is turned down; keep true peak below -1 dBTP.

COVERAGE
Good for wobble and tape. No VHS noise generator; the drums are synthesized one-shots: use your own breaks for
their sound.

SOURCES
Pitchfork "The Downtempo Duo" (2005), transcript at bocpages.org; Spotify for Artists, "Loudness normalization" (support.spotify.com/us/artists/article/loudness-normalization).

FREE PLUG-INS (download them before opening the template; a missing one keeps its slot)
- OB-Xf (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/surge-synthesizer/OB-Xf
- CHOWTapeModel (GPL-3.0): https://chowdsp.com/products.html
- Surge XT (GPL-3.0): https://surge-synthesizer.github.io/
- kHs Bitcrush (freeware (Kilohearts Essentials, free account)): https://kilohearts.com/products/kilohearts_essentials

SETUP (written from this template)
Tempo 92 BPM, 4/4, key Dmin, cycle bars 1-8.

Tracks
- Drums (Instrument, +0 dB) -> Drum Bus
    instrument: Channel Rack (synthesized one-shots of the template samples: Kick = kick-acoustic.wav, Snare = snare-acoustic.wav, Closed Hat = hat-acoustic.wav, Open Hat = openhat-acoustic.wav, Rim = rim.wav, Shaker = shaker.wav)
    region: Step Sequencer pattern with a starter beat (13 steps on), swing 54% (MPC terms), 6 rows = the rack's channels
- Detuned Pad (Instrument, -8 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Pads/Childhood"
    FX: chowdsp: CHOWTapeModel: factory preset "Slightly Wobbly"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -10 dB
- Lead (Instrument, -10 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Plucks/VHS Soundtrack"
    FX: chowdsp: CHOWTapeModel: factory preset "Woozy Chorus"
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -14 dB
- Bass (Instrument, -8 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Basses/Retrowaver"
- Voice Fragments (Instrument, -12 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Sampler (SP-303 model): effect Pitch on, CTRL 1-3 = 45%, 20%, 80%; quantize 16; pad grade standard
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -8 dB

Buses (the n-th Aux strip listens to bus n)
- Drum Bus (bus 1): Kilohearts: kHs Bitcrush: default settings; Rate 0.875, Bits 0.7333, Mix 0.6; Compressor (Threshold -24, Ratio 8, Attack 1, Release 80, Make-up 6)
- Music Bus (bus 2): chowdsp: CHOWTapeModel: factory preset "Disintegrated Memories"
- Vocal Bus (bus 3): empty
- Reverb (bus 4): Space D (Dry -96, Wet 0, Decay 3.5, Decay Curve 1, IR "03.0s Long Reverb")
- Delay (bus 5): Tape Delay (Time 978.3, Feedback 0.45, Tone 3500, Mix 1)

Stereo Out
- built-in effects: Channel EQ (High -1.5); Compressor (Threshold -16, Ratio 1.8, Attack 30, Release 200)
- plug-ins (after the built-in effects): chowdsp: CHOWTapeModel: factory preset "Warm Tape"; Lemon Limiter: gain +2 dB, ceiling -1 dB, other settings default

Bring your own samples: no recordings are included.
